title: Fix Procedural 3D Hover Resetting Flow Camera
description: Bug in procedural 3d: hovering over 3d elements resets the camera on the flow. Likely the hover-driven scene rebuild re-applies fixture/default viewport onto the flow graph instead of preserving the live pan/zoom. Fix at the root so hover (and other ephemeral view updates) never reset the flow camera.
summary: Hovering procedural 3D meshes re-rendered the flow graph and loadFixtureJson replaced the live camera with the stale document camera. FlowHost::apply_fixture now preserves camera (like undo/redo), FlowSession exposes cameraJson, procedural 2d/3d keep graph camera in runtime as a view action, and fixture diffs no longer emit SetCamera. Vitest viewport helper passed; cargo unit tests blocked by unrelated concurrent protocol UI-node field breakage.
